observed: [idle-census] repo=stSoftwareAU/NEAT-AI work_on=4 inversion_signal=true — while the scan logged milestone-occupied=4 and the audit logged claimable=0 reason=stream_occupied
note: The opposite direction to #499: here the scan was right and the census was wrong. Every work-on issue sat in a work stream already hosting a worker-assigned issue, so the scan refused all four; the census did not model stream occupancy and filed an issue against a repo whose work was simply already being done. The disagreement, not the issue numbers, is what this records. Issue #2532 changed what the fleet should do with this state: `top-priority` and `work-on` claims share a busy stream in their own fresh conversation, so all four are claimable now and the scan takes one. The recorded state is unchanged — what it must never produce again is a census-versus-scan disagreement.
